ap-now.title: M ap etidye
ap-now.bodyMarkdown:
Use **ap** before an action to describe something in progress:

- **M ap etidye.** — I am studying.
- **Li ap travay.** — He/she is working.
- **Yo ap manje.** — They are eating.

The important beginner pattern is: **person + ap + action**.

common-short-forms.title: M ap, W ap, L ap, N ap, Y ap
common-short-forms.bodyMarkdown:
In normal Kreyòl, subject pronouns often appear in shortened forms before **ap**:

- **M ap** — I am...
- **W ap** — you are...
- **L ap** — he/she is...
- **N ap** — we are...
- **Y ap** — they are...

You will see both full and shortened subject forms as you continue.

kounyeya.title: kounyeya
kounyeya.bodyMarkdown:
**kounyeya** means “now.” You can add it when the time matters:

**Jan ap travay kounyeya.** — Jan is working now.

The sentence still uses the same **ap + action** pattern.
